summary: Added shacl_path(graph, node) to rdflib/paths.py, converting a sh:path object into a URIRef or Path (inverse, alternative, zeroOrMore/oneOrMore/zeroOrOne, RDF-list sequences; ValueError on malformed input). Added 37 passing tests in test/test_path.py plus doctests; test/test_path.py and paths doctests pass. Correction to earlier report: the full background test/test_sparql run finished with 4 failed, 392 passed, 18 xfailed. Visible failures are all in test/test_sparql/test_service.py (test_service, test_service_with_bound_solutions, test_service_with_values; the fourth name was not recoverable from the output). I have not verified whether these predate my change, and they do not exercise shacl_path. Nothing committed; only rdflib/paths.py and test/test_path.py changed.
